N1pIYI5JQLE.title: Richard Feynman Fire
N1pIYI5JQLE.summary: A short clip from a Richard Feynman interview in which he explains fire, describing how burning wood releases sunlight stored by the tree, which built itself mostly from air. It showcases his curiosity and plain-spoken explanations.
N1pIYI5JQLE.why: HN repeatedly cites it as an elegant, eye-opening explanation of fire and photosynthesis and as an example of Feynman's infectious love of knowledge.

quote.text: it's impossible to stay in any kind of negative mood if you watch Feynman

R7EEoWg6Ekk.title: Break Me00 The MoVfuscator Turning mov into a soul crushing RE nightmare Christopher Domas
R7EEoWg6Ekk.summary: Christopher Domas's Derbycon 2015 talk on the M/o/Vfuscator, a compiler that emits only x86 mov instructions, showing mov is Turing complete. It explains how a full machine is built from mov and why the output is a nightmare to reverse engineer.
R7EEoWg6Ekk.why: HN calls it a legendary, clearly explained hacker talk whenever mov-only computing or anti-decompilation comes up.

quote.text: Christopher Domas's conference talk on the movfuscator is legendary

NHopJHSlVo4.title: Keep your goals to yourself | Derek Sivers
NHopJHSlVo4.summary: A four-minute TED talk in which Derek Sivers argues that announcing your goals can make you less likely to achieve them. He cites psychology research going back to the 1920s.
NHopJHSlVo4.why: Commenters credit it with changing how they handle plans and recommend it as a short, sourced talk.

quote.text: I did not really put two and two together until I saw this talk[0] many years ago and it clicked.

AItTqnTsVjA.title: The GUI should be better.  A lot better.
AItTqnTsVjA.summary: Accursed Farms' hour-plus critique of the modern desktop GUI. It argues that current interfaces are a regression from older designs such as Windows 7 and proposes principles for better ones.
AItTqnTsVjA.why: Recommended as a thought-provoking critique that makes people notice how poor everyday GUIs are.

quote.text: this video cursed me to pay far more attention on how shitty modern GUI is in my everyday interaction with the computer and phone

eC7xzavzEKY.title: THIS IS WATER! by David Foster Wallace
eC7xzavzEKY.summary: A short video of David Foster Wallace's 'This Is Water' commencement speech about awareness and choosing how to think. It argues that the most obvious realities are the hardest to see, using the fish-in-water parable.
eC7xzavzEKY.why: HN commenters bring it up when urging empathy, patience and attention to the everyday instead of snap judgement.

quote.text: suggest you watch David Foster Wallace's "This is Water," and when you're done, please watch it again.

iRleB034EC8.title: Peter Thiel on “The Straussian Moment”
iRleB034EC8.tz: 彼得·蒂尔谈《斯特劳斯时刻》
iRleB034EC8.summary: Peter Robinson interviews Peter Thiel at the Hoover Institution about Thiel's essay The Straussian Moment. Thiel discusses how people trust the will more than the intellect and reason, and how the question of human nature has been abandoned.
iRleB034EC8.sz: 在 Hoover Institution，Peter Robinson 访谈 Peter Thiel，讨论其文章《The Straussian Moment》，Thiel 认为人们更信任意志而非理性，且对人性问题的探讨已被抛弃。
iRleB034EC8.why: HN points to it as a primer on Thiel's thinking and as an example of Peter Robinson's skill as an interviewer.
iRleB034EC8.wz: 被推荐为了解蒂尔思想及 Robinson 访谈技巧的入门材料。

quote.text: There is a Peter Robinson interview about the essay that can serve as a good primer[1].

s0ukXDnWlTY.title: The Smartphone CPU Review You NEED to Watch!
s0ukXDnWlTY.tz: 必看手机 CPU 评测
s0ukXDnWlTY.summary: Geekerwan reviews smartphone CPUs by power efficiency rather than benchmark scores, with test methodology and chapters on Qualcomm, Apple, Samsung and Google chips. It explains why high benchmark scores can coexist with heat and poor battery life.
s0ukXDnWlTY.sz: Geekerwan 以功耗效率而非跑分为核心评测手机 CPU，介绍了测试方法并分别分析了 Qualcomm、Apple、Samsung、Google 的芯片，解释了高分数为何仍会伴随发热和电池耗损。
s0ukXDnWlTY.why: HN people cite it as detailed data on mobile SoC efficiency, sustained performance and ARM core efficiency curves.
s0ukXDnWlTY.wz: 因其提供了移动 SoC 效率的详尽数据和性能曲线，受到技术社区青睐。

quote.text: explores the power efficiency graphs and that's probably what most phone users really want

8dhp_20j0Ys.title: How Toy Story 2 Almost Got Deleted: Stories From Pixar Animation: ENTV
8dhp_20j0Ys.summary: Pixar staff tell the story of how Toy Story 2 was almost deleted from the studio's computers and was saved by a home computer backup.
8dhp_20j0Ys.why: HN shares it as a classic backup and operations cautionary tale.

quote.text: which I highly recommend if you are in storage, DevOps or SRE

UDtlvZGmHYk.title: Spider With Three Super Powers | The Hunt | BBC Earth
UDtlvZGmHYk.summary: A BBC Earth clip from The Hunt showing Portia jumping spiders, which leap many times their body length and ambush prey larger than themselves.
UDtlvZGmHYk.why: HN recommends it as striking footage of how cleverly jumping spiders plan their attacks.

quote.text: Well worth the watch if it’s new to you! Quite the perspective shifter

e0elNU0iOMY.title: The hidden background noise that can catch criminals
e0elNU0iOMY.tz: 隐藏的背景噪声如何捕获罪犯
e0elNU0iOMY.summary: Tom Scott explains Electrical Network Frequency analysis, where hum from the power grid in a recording is matched against grid logs to date and place it. He talks to a researcher and sets them a challenge.
e0elNU0iOMY.sz: Tom Scott 解释电网频率（ENF）分析技术，即通过录音中的电网嗡嗡声匹配电网日志来确定时间和地点，并与研究者对话设挑战。
e0elNU0iOMY.why: The go-to short, accessible explainer for mains hum forensics, linked whenever recording authenticity or timestamps come up.
e0elNU0iOMY.wz: 成为电网嗡嗡声取证的入门短片，常在讨论录音真实性或时间戳时被引用。

quote.text: less detailed but pretty accessible video [1] explaining how mains hum forensics work

hSrGfElyfVE.title: altitude chamber hypoxia training guy passes out
hSrGfElyfVE.tz: 高空舱缺氧训练中有人晕倒
hSrGfElyfVE.summary: Footage of FAA altitude chamber hypoxia training for pilots in which a participant passes out from oxygen deprivation. It shows how quickly and subtly cognition fails at altitude.
hSrGfElyfVE.sz: FAA 为飞行员进行的高空舱缺氧训练视频，记录了一名受训者因缺氧而失去意识。展示了高海拔环境下认知功能快速且微妙的衰退。
hSrGfElyfVE.why: Linked as a vivid demonstration of how fast hypoxia incapacitates people, often without them noticing.
hSrGfElyfVE.wz: 作为缺氧对人体快速致残的直观案例被频繁链接。

quote.text: Watch this video[1] of pilot training in an FAA altitude chamber to see the effects of oxygen deprivation.

oFfVt3S51T4.title: Cursor Team: Future of Programming with AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #447
oFfVt3S51T4.tz: Cursor 团队：AI 编程的未来 | Lex Fridman Podcast #447
oFfVt3S51T4.summary: A Lex Fridman podcast conversation with the four creators of Cursor, the AI-assisted code editor. They discuss how the editor integrates models into programming workflows, including custom completion models and techniques like speculative decoding to speed up applying edits.
oFfVt3S51T4.sz: 在 Lex Fridman 的播客中，Cursor 四位创始人阐述了 AI 辅助代码编辑器的工作原理，包括自定义补全模型和投机解码等加速编辑的技术。
oFfVt3S51T4.why: HN commenters point to it as the best first-hand account of Cursor's technical internals, straight from its founders.
oFfVt3S51T4.wz: HN 认为它是了解 Cursor 技术细节的最佳第一手资料。

quote.text: The founders did an episode on Lex Fridman's podcast that covers the technical sides of Cursor far better than I ever could

-r2oaQWmqkk.title: "Pyramid UFO" - NEW FOOTAGE. It's Just Bokeh, not a Pyramid
-r2oaQWmqkk.summary: Mick West shows new night-vision reference footage indicating the Navy's supposed flying pyramid UFO is just an out-of-focus light, likely a plane near LAX, rendered triangular by bokeh. He identifies other lights as Jupiter and stars.
-r2oaQWmqkk.why: HN cites it as a concise debunking of a UFO case and an illustration of how a triangular aperture creates triangle UFOs.

quote.text: The linked video in the article showing how a triangle iris creates triangle ufos is brilliant, and seems obvious after you see it.

c01BlUDIlK4.title: Moore's Law is Not Dead (Jim Keller) | AI Podcast Clips
c01BlUDIlK4.tz: 摩尔定律未死（Jim Keller）| AI 播客剪辑
c01BlUDIlK4.summary: A clip from Lex Fridman's podcast in which chip architect Jim Keller argues that Moore's Law is not dead and that transistor scaling still has lots of room. He also discusses how to break down hard problems.
c01BlUDIlK4.sz: 本片段取自 Lex Fridman 的播客，芯片架构师 Jim Keller 认为摩尔定律仍然有效，晶体管缩放仍有大量空间。他还讨论了拆解难题的方法。
c01BlUDIlK4.why: Used to support the argument that chip engineers see plenty of scaling headroom left.
c01BlUDIlK4.wz: HN 用它来证明芯片工程师仍认为还有足够的缩放空间。

quote.text: According to Jim Keller, yes, there is.

7d59O6cfaM0.title: holoportation: virtual 3D teleportation in real-time (Microsoft Research)
7d59O6cfaM0.summary: Microsoft Research demonstrates holoportation, which reconstructs and compresses high-quality 3D models of people in real time and sends them anywhere. With a HoloLens, remote participants appear as if present in your room.
7d59O6cfaM0.why: Cited as the benchmark demo for telepresence and photorealistic avatars, in discussions of remote work and VR.

quote.text: Holoportation looks very neat I really hope I get to try it one day.

lFIYKmos3-s.title: Richard Feynman - Names Don't Constitute Knowledge
lFIYKmos3-s.summary: A short excerpt from a 1973 Yorkshire TV film in which Richard Feynman explains that knowing the name of something is not the same as knowing it.
lFIYKmos3-s.why: Shared to end arguments over definitions and terminology, and as a reminder that memorizing names is not understanding.

quote.text: when people start quibbling over words I like to point them to this feynman video.
